name: RAMMap 内存分析
tagline: 微软官方内存分析工具，看清内存到底被谁占了
taglineEn: Microsoft's official memory analysis tool — see what is using your RAM
description: RAMMap 是 Microsoft Sysinternals 出品的系统内存分析工具，能详细展示物理内存的使用构成：各进程占用、文件缓存（Standby / Modified）、驱动锁定内存、分页与非分页池等，并支持手动清空待机列表、系统工作集、已修改页面列表等。适合排查「内存被吃满」「磁盘缓存过大」「关机/休眠异常」等问题。官方出品，免安装，解压即用。
descriptionEn: RAMMap from Microsoft Sysinternals analyzes system memory in detail: per-process usage, file cache (standby/modified), driver-locked memory, paged and nonpaged pools, and more. It can manually clear the standby list, system working set and modified page list. Use it to diagnose full memory, oversized disk cache, or shutdown and sleep issues. It is portable and runs after extraction.
author: Microsoft

downloads.note: 微软官方直链；解压后运行 RAMMap.exe（右键管理员运行）
